PLAN "12-Week General Strength (Post-L4-L5 Safe)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength while avoiding heavy spinal loading and loaded flexion"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Motor Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body + Core (Spine-Safe)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Push/Pull Basics":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body Unilateral + Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body + Core (Progress)":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x8 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x14 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Push/Pull (Progress)":

          lateral_raise 3x14 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds

          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower Unilateral + Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m

          split_squat 4x8 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 4x10 rpe 6..7 rest 75 seconds

    WEEK 3:
